# Reef rock: a jittered icosahedron, flat shaded. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.55 --location 0 0 0.2
scale 1.3 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.09 --seed 5
mode object
material new Rock --base-color 0.0 0.373 0.549
shade flat
export rock.glb
